text:
Tess (People Ops): Hey team — putting together a compact 30/60/90 goal + self-review template for new hires that managers can use during onboarding. Looking for a short, copy-pasteable version for eng managers. Any quick examples? :wave:

Priya (SW Eng): I use a tiny structure: 30 = learn + small fix, 60 = own a small feature, 90 = lead a minor project. For self-review prompts keep to 3 bullets: learnings, wins, next steps.

Miguel (Infra Manager): +1. Add measurable success criteria (e.g., "merge 2 infra PRs", "onboard one service to observability"). Also include who they should meet (stakeholders) for cross-team exposure.

Sam (Talent): Please keep language inclusive and plain — avoid heavy ramp jargon. HR needs a simple completion flag so we can surface in L2 reviews. Can we add a checkbox row managers can tick?

Tess (People Ops): Drafting a pasteable template below — extremely compact so it fits in an onboarding checklist. Feel free to edit.

Tess (People Ops): ```
30 days — Goal: [what], Success: [metric/observable], Support: [who to ask]
60 days — Goal: [what], Success: [metric], Support: [who]
90 days — Goal: [what], Success: [metric], Impact: [short statement]

Self-review (end of 90d):
- 2 things I learned
- 1 win I’m proud of (metric or outcome)
- 1 area to improve + plan
- 1 ask from my manager

Manager checklist:
[ ] 30d done   [ ] 60d done   [ ] 90d done
Manager notes: [short note]
```

Priya (SW Eng): Can you paste the exact text into the onboarding doc so I can drop it into the cohort template?

Tess (People Ops): Sure — I’ll add it to Confluence under "New hire playbooks" and link from the engineering onboarding checklist.

Miguel (Infra Manager): Suggest adding an optional single-line "Impact statement" for 90d so new hires learn to summarize value: e.g., "Reduced queue time by 20% for X flow."

Sam (Talent): Also adding the 3 checkboxes to our tracking sheet. HR will surface completed flags for manager calibration.

Priya (SW Eng): Great — I’ll add to eng onboarding doc and ping managers to adopt this for the next cohort.

hr-bot: Reminder: New hire probation milestone at 90 days — submit completion form: https://redwood.example.com/hr/probation :memo:

Tess (People Ops): Thanks everyone — closing this thread once the Confluence update is live. I’ll post the link here and in #eng-onboarding. :heart:
